meta.title: Tomoe — Japanese restaurant in the Eixample, Barcelona
meta.description: Sushi counter, omakase and tempura on Carrer de València. Fish from Mercabarna and Toyosu, dashi made each morning, forty sakes by the glass or bottle.

hero.title: Japanese cooking on Carrer de València, five minutes from Passeig de Gràcia.
hero.lead: A twelve-seat hinoki counter and a small dining room. Dashi made every morning, fish from Mercabarna and Tokyo's Toyosu market, and forty sakes to drink with it.

story.label: Story
story.title: What we do in the kitchen, and why.
story.intro: Chef Kenta Mori trained for nine years in Kanazawa before moving to Barcelona in 2019. The cooking is Japanese in technique; much of the produce comes from Catalonia.

dashi.title: Broth made at nine every morning
dashi.body: Rishiri kombu soaked overnight in soft water, then katsuobushi shaved to order. It is the base of our soups, simmered dishes and the tempura dipping sauce.

fish.title: Two markets, one counter
fish.body: Red prawns, sea bream and mackerel come from Catalan boats via Mercabarna each morning. Tuna and seasonal shellfish arrive from Toyosu twice a week.

sake.title: Forty sakes, chosen with the food
sake.body: Our sommelier pairs junmai and ginjo from small breweries with each course of the omakase. Also available by the glass.

counter.title: A single plank of hinoki
counter.body: Each piece of nigiri is shaped and served in front of you, at the temperature it was meant to be eaten.

chef.title: Aged, cured, lightly seared
chef.body: Fish is dry-aged for between two and ten days depending on the cut. Rice is seasoned with red vinegar from Yokoi.

season.title: October menu
season.body: Sanma from Hokkaido, Delta de l'Ebre rice, wild mushrooms from the Pyrenees.

menu.label: Menu
menu.title: Menu highlights
menu.intro: A selection from the current menu. Dishes change with the market; the full list is printed daily.

notes.omakase: Served at the counter only. Please tell us about allergies when booking.
notes.tempura: Fried in sesame and cottonseed oil.
notes.sake: Price per glass (90 ml) / per bottle (720 ml).

kiwami.name: Kiwami omakase
kiwami.desc: Eighteen courses: appetisers, sashimi, a seasonal hot dish and twelve pieces of nigiri.

shun.name: Shun omakase
shun.desc: Twelve courses built around the fish of the day.

lunch.name: Lunch nigiri set
lunch.desc: Ten pieces of nigiri, miso soup and tamagoyaki. Tuesday to Sunday, lunch only.

shojin.name: Shōjin course
shojin.desc: Nine vegetarian courses in the Buddhist temple tradition. Kombu and shiitake dashi.

otoro.name: Ōtoro
otoro.desc: Fatty bluefin tuna belly, aged for five days.

gamba.name: Palamós red prawn
gamba.desc: Raw, with a little of its own coral.

moriawase.name: Sashimi selection
moriawase.desc: Five kinds from the morning market, for two.

yasai.name: Seasonal vegetable tempura
yasai.desc: Six pieces from the Maresme and our Pyrenean suppliers.

anago.name: Whole conger eel tempura
anago.desc: Served with matcha salt and grated daikon.

tendon.name: Tendon (lunch only)
tendon.desc: Tempura over rice with a sweet soy sauce. Vegetable version available.

kokuryu.name: Kokuryū Ginjo
kokuryu.desc: Fukui. Dry and light — good with sashimi.

nabeshima.name: Nabeshima Tokubetsu Junmai
nabeshima.desc: Saga. Rounder, with rice and banana notes.

pairing.name: Sake pairing
pairing.desc: Five glasses chosen for the Kiwami or Shun omakase.

menu.allergenNote: Allergen information follows EU Regulation 1169/2011. Ask our staff for the full list.

location.label: Location
location.title: Find us
location.transport: Passeig de Gràcia (L2, L3, L4, Rodalies) — 5 min walk. Bicing station at Rambla de Catalunya.
location.dress: Smart casual. Please avoid strong perfume at the counter.
